en.title: Little Fox and the Brave Breath
en.heroLook: a small orange fox with a fluffy white-tipped tail, big kind eyes and soft round ears

pages.text: Little Fox lived at the edge of a sunny forest. Every morning she said hello to the flowers.
pages.scene: a small orange fox waving at bright flowers at the edge of a sunny forest

pages.text: One day her favourite ball rolled away. Little Fox felt worried. Her tummy felt tight.
pages.scene: a small orange fox looking worried as a red ball rolls away between tall trees

pages.text: Little Fox stopped. She took a slow, deep breath in, and a long breath out. Then she asked her friend Owl to help.
pages.scene: a small orange fox breathing calmly with eyes closed beside a fluffy grey owl on a branch

pages.text: Together they found the ball under a big leaf. It is okay to feel worried. Asking for help can make it smaller.
pages.scene: a happy orange fox and a grey owl finding a red ball under a big green leaf

question.text: What helped Little Fox when she felt worried?

ar.title: الثعلبة الصغيرة والنفس الشجاع
ar.heroLook: a small orange fox with a fluffy white-tipped tail, big kind eyes and soft round ears

pages.text: عاشت الثعلبة الصغيرة على طرف غابة مشمسة. وكل صباح كانت تحيّي الزهور.
pages.scene: a small orange fox waving at bright flowers at the edge of a sunny forest

pages.text: في أحد الأيام تدحرجت كرتها المفضلة بعيدًا. شعرت الثعلبة الصغيرة بالقلق، وشعرت بضيق في بطنها.
pages.scene: a small orange fox looking worried as a red ball rolls away between tall trees

pages.text: توقفت الثعلبة الصغيرة. أخذت نفسًا عميقًا وبطيئًا، ثم أخرجته طويلًا. ثم طلبت من صديقتها البومة أن تساعدها.
pages.scene: a small orange fox breathing calmly with eyes closed beside a fluffy grey owl on a branch

pages.text: وجدتا الكرة معًا تحت ورقة كبيرة. لا بأس أن نشعر بالقلق، وطلب المساعدة يجعله أصغر.
pages.scene: a happy orange fox and a grey owl finding a red ball under a big green leaf

question.text: ما الذي ساعد الثعلبة الصغيرة عندما شعرت بالقلق؟
